# Osama Mumtaz

> Technical Product Manager and Senior Software Engineer based in Islamabad, Pakistan, with 7+ years in mobile. Leads Android, QA, design and AI teams at Funsol Technologies, has shipped 50+ apps to the Google Play Store, and builds web tools alongside mobile products. Available for new opportunities, consulting and contract work.

Osama Mumtaz works at the intersection of product management and hands-on
engineering: setting roadmaps and leading cross-functional teams while still
writing production code. His specialism is Android — Kotlin, Jetpack Compose,
Compose Multiplatform, Firebase — plus AI-assisted product features and
Play Store growth and monetisation.

## Projects

- [Turbo Shield VPN](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.turboshieldvpn.fastsecure.vpn): Android VPN client with kill switch, IPv6 leak blocking, split tunnelling, Cloudflare DNS, smart server selection and per-session bandwidth recaps.
- [ReelstoMP4](https://reelstomp4.com/): Free web tool that converts public Facebook reel and video links into downloadable MP4s in HD, with no signup and no stored data.
- [GeoPromptTracker](https://geoprompttracker.com/): Free GEO toolkit of 19 tools for making sites readable and citable by AI search, including an llms.txt generator, FAQPage JSON-LD generator, an AI-Readiness Audit and a directory of 28 AI crawlers.
- [sssxdown](https://sssxdown.com/): Free web tool for saving public videos and GIFs from X (Twitter), with no login, no watermark and nothing stored server-side.
- SnapLingo: Cross-platform AI language learning app for children built in Compose Multiplatform, with AI-generated lessons, an AI chat tutor, gamification and family progress tracking.
- [Live Wallpapers 4K, HD, Anime](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.wallpaperapp.hdwallpapers.livewallpaperfree.coolwallpapers): Personalisation app with an AI wallpaper generator and a categorised library of 4K, 3D and 4D parallax wallpapers.
- [PDF Scanner: Document Reader](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.docscan.camscan.pdfscanner.pagescanner.documentscanner): Document scanning utility that turns a phone camera into a portable scanner for multi-page documents, ID cards and books.
